goal: Every model call in ga-sdk passes through one gateway that meters it and enforces budgets.
why: LLM-minimum and token-loop principles must hold by structure, not by prompts.
acceptance: a test fails if any module calls a backend outside the gateway
each call appends one ledger row: input, output, cache_read, cache_write, usd, rung, n_items, caller
one definition of a paid call is used by every cap, budget and ledger
per-session and per-day token/USD budgets fail closed and emit an alert
items that arrive in the same tick can be sent as one call with one fixed template; batch size is capped by a value Ops sets
constraints: spec only: Dev/Ops decide method and plan
